summary: Basel Medical Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing a 1-for-12 reverse share split effective June 22, 2026, to regain compliance with Nasdaq's minimum $1 bid price rule. No shareholder approval was required under British Virgin Islands law. The share count will reduce from 18,785,750 to ~1,565,480; fractional shares will be rounded up. The stock will trade under the same symbol BMGL with a new CUSIP. This is a capital structure adjustment, not a special situation, intended to avoid delisting. Watch for Nasdaq compliance confirmation post-split.
